# SnapKitty Collective

> Sovereign AI infrastructure. Models, agents, formal proofs, GPU kernels, and open research — built to be inspected, verified, and run independently.

## What This Is

SnapKitty is a 130+ repository ecosystem for building sovereign AI systems. Every decision is WORM-sealed (append-only SHA-256 audit chain). Every proof compiles with zero sorry terms. Everything runs local on consumer hardware.

## Organization

- GitHub: https://github.com/SNAPKITTYWEST
- Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/Snapkitty
- Website: https://collectivekitty.com

## Core Areas

### Sovereign Models
Small, local-first language models. Nemotron Mini 4.2B fine-tunes, 4B reward models, deterministic routing tensors, GGUF exports for Ollama.
- sovereign-mimo-4b: 4B param code reward model pruned from MiMo-7B
- sovereign-qra: Deterministic routing tensor replacing softmax (Lean 4 zero-sorry)
- snapkitty-merged: Nemotron Mini 4.2B GGUF (Q4_K_M)
- hilbert: CUDA kernels (RMSNorm, FlashAttn, SwiGLU, RoPE) for Ampere GPUs

### Agent Systems
Multi-agent orchestration with formal verification gates.
- bob-engine: Haskell + quantum monad + Watson + Mamba SSM + Prolog kernel
- sovereign-agent-kernel: 6502 bare-metal, Forth runtime, SHA-512
- sovereign-agi-kernel: Idris 2 dependent types, entropy bounds as types
- agentscope-sift: Security Intelligence and Forensic Triage

### Formal Verification
Zero-sorry Lean 4 theorems, Agda formalizations, cross-language verification.
- sov-kernel-monster: Sovereign method repository, proofs and specs
- ahmad-foundations: NLBHE, E7 lattice, F4 algebra, 30+ zero-sorry theorems
- sovereign-entropy-theorem: Hallucination elimination (H < 0.20 nats)
- j-matrix-twin: 79 Jacobian theorems with interactive playground

### Quantum Computing
Topological quantum computing, Fibonacci anyons, lattice surgery.
- topological-quantum-computer: Fibonacci-anyon TQC with Lean 4 proofs
- quantum-kernel: TDA-to-braid-to-lattice surgery for heavy-hex hardware
- black-hole-engine: Hawking temperature, ISCO, photon sphere proofs

### GPU Kernels and Hardware
CUDA, bare-metal processors, space flight computers.
- hilbert: CUDA kernels for Ampere GPUs
- sovereign-ada-rtx: Complete processor in pure Ada, 21 packages
- sovereign-agc: Apollo Guidance Computer in 7 languages
- sovereign-hypervisor-sdk: ARM64 EL2 hypervisor API

### Compilers and Runtimes
From LISP machines to Apple II to sovereign WASM sandboxes.
- sovereign-compiler: Root Fontana constitutional compiler (Rust + Lean 4)
- sovereign-emulator: VM for governed agents with constitution engine
- apple-ii-universal-machine: Apple II with sovereign overlay
- snapkitty-clojure-lisp-bridge: LISP machine with EmojiScript bytecode

### Security and Cryptography
Ed25519 + Blake3 + SHA-256. WORM audit chains. Hardware attestation.
- sovereign-attestation-protocol: TPM 2.0, SGX, TrustZone
- vault-live: SAML 2.0 with NAND-gated assertion validation
- woz-vault: Ed25519 hardware key vault
- marlborg-worm: Append-only SHA-256 audit trail

### Datasets
- sovereign-training-corpus: 882 curated prompt/completion pairs from WORM-sealed execution
- cartographer-corpus: 67 domain-specific examples across 9 chapters
- worm-chain-archive: 39 MB of cryptographically sealed execution records
- sovereign-papers: 25 LaTeX research papers

### Research
- sovereign-tournament: Formal math tournament, 8 published papers
- snapkitty-papers: Architecture, PIRTM, octonions, EmojiScript, Goldilocks

## Key Properties

- Zero sorry terms: All Lean 4 proofs compile without axiom admits
- WORM sealed: Append-only SHA-256 chains on every agent decision
- Local first: Everything runs on consumer GPUs (RTX 3080)
- 20+ languages: Lean 4, Agda, Ada, Haskell, Fortran, Prolog, 6502 ASM, OCaml, Idris 2, Rust, CUDA, and more
- Formally verified: Proofs from algebra to hardware
